flags.reason: Contains πνίγω (G4155), ἀποπνίγω (G0638), συμπνίγω (G4846) meaning choke/strangle/suffocate. These are violence/harm verbs, not religious activities.
Refuge/shelter (חָסוּת H2622, עוּז H5756, צָפָה H6822) is about safety and protection, not supernatural beings. LN21 (Danger, Risk, Safe, Save) fits better.
Contains Rahab proper name variants: רָהָב (H7294, H7293, H7343), Ῥαάβ (G4460), Rachab (G4477). These are proper names, not numbers.
Contains יָרָק H3419 (vegetables/herbs), λάχανον G3001 (garden herb), זֵרֹעַ H2235 (vegetables/seed). These are plants/vegetables, not artifacts.
χαρίζομαι (G5483) and δωρέομαι (G1433) primarily mean 'grant, give freely'. The community mixes giving and forgiving senses but is weighted toward transfer/gift, not reconciliation.
Contains θρῆσκος (G2357, religious), εὐλαβής (G2126, devout/reverent), εὐσεβής (G2153, pious), εὐσέβεια (G2152, piety/godliness). These are religious qualities/activities, not existence.
Contains ὁμόφρων (G3675, like-minded), σύμψυχος (G4861, united in spirit), ἰσόψυχος (G2473, like-minded). These express shared mental disposition, not numbers.
Contains מַלָּח (H4419, mariner/sailor), ναύτης (G3492, sailor), חֹבֵל (H2259, ship pilot). These are maritime personnel, should be LN54.
Apostasy (סוּג H5253 'backslide', ὑποστέλλω G5288 'draw back/shrink') is about abandoning belief, not physical movement. LN31 captures the spiritual apostasy sense.

Contains οἰνοφλυγία (G3632, drunkenness), κραιπάλη (G2897, carousing), πότος (G4224, drinking bout), שִׁכָּרוֹן (H7943, intoxication), μέθη (G3178, drunkenness). All physiological states, not communication.

Contains βλαστός (G0986, shoot/bud), יוֹנֵק (H3126, young shoot/suckling), שֶׁלַח (H7973, branch/shoot). Despite also containing στρῆνος and τρυφή, the core cluster is about plant shoots, not association.
Contains שָׂרַר (H7786, contend/rule), אָבַק (H0079, wrestle), שָׂרָה (H8280, contend/persist/strive). These denote struggle and contest, not religious activities.
Contains עֵדֶר II (H5740a), עֵדֶר III (H5740b), מִגְדַּל־עֵדֶר (H4029, Migdal-eder), עֶדֶר (H5738). These are proper place names (Eder, Migdal-eder), not time terms.
Contains δοκός (G1385, beam/rafter), עֵב (H5646, thick plank), גֵּב (H1356, beam?), קוֹרָה (H6982, rafter/beam), כָּפִיס (H3714, beam). These are structural building elements.
Contains דֶּבֶק (H1694, joint/sinew), ἁφή (G0860, joint/ligament), ἁρμός (G0719, joint/articulation). These are body joints and ligaments, not foods.
Contains קָסַס (H7082, cut off stubble), סָעַף (H5586, lop/trim branches), תָּזָה (H8456, cut/prune). These are agricultural pruning/cutting actions, not supernatural beings.
Contains πινακίδιον (G4094, writing tablet), παροψίς (G3953, dish/side-dish), τρύβλιον (G5165, bowl/dish), צַלַּחַת (H6747, dish). These are household vessels/artifacts, not religious activities.
Contains חָבַשׁ (H2280, bind), אָפַד (H0640, bind/gird), צוּר (H6696, bind), עָקַד (H6123, bind/tie up). The dominant sense is binding/constraining, not communication.
Contains ὁδηγός (G3595, guide/leader), χειραγωγός (G5497, one who leads by hand), καθηγητής (G2519, teacher/guide). These are about guidance/leadership, not numbers.
Contains דְּרוֹר II (H1866, swallow bird) and סוּס I (H5483a, swallow/swift). These are bird species (swallows), not concepts of control or rule.
Contains ἔξοδος (G1841, departure/exodus), ἄφιξις (G0867, arrival), ἀνάλυσις (G0359, departure/dissolution). These are about movement/departure, not supernatural beings.
Contains ἀστήρικτος (G0793, unstable), ἀκατάστατος (G0182, unstable/restless), פַּחַז (H6349, reckless/wanton). These describe character instability, not numbers.
Contains דּוֹר/Dor (H1756, city name), עֵין־דֹּר/En-dor (H5874, place name), חַמֹּת דֹּאר/Hammoth-dor (H2576, place name). These are geographic proper names.
Contains προέχω (G4284, excel/surpass), ὑπερέχω (G5242, be superior/surpass), ὑπερβάλλω (G5235, surpass/exceed). These express degree of superiority, not supernatural beings.
Contains ἀποκυλίω (G0617, roll away), πτύσσω (G4428, fold up), προσκυλίω (G4351, roll toward). These are rolling/folding motions, not association.
Contains ἐπιούσιος (G1967, daily/for the coming day), καθημερινός (G2522, daily), ἐφήμερος (G2184, for the day/daily). These are temporal terms, not activity verbs.
Contains προσδοκία (G4329, expectation), ἀποκαραδοκία (G0603, eager expectation), and δόξα (G1561, in its sense of 'expectation'). These express anticipation/attitude, not physical events.
Contains צְבַע (H6647, dip/dye), βάπτω (G0911, dip), ἐμβάπτω (G1686, dip in). These are physical actions of dipping/dyeing involving liquids, not moral qualities.
Contains עֶזֶר (H5827, Ezer personal name), אֶבֶן הָעֵזֶר (H0072, Ebenezer place name), רֹמַמְתִּי עֶזֶר (H7320, Romamti-ezer name), עֵזֶר II (H5829, Ezer). All proper names.
Contains βέλος (G0956, arrow/missile), ῥαφίς (G4476, needle), שֵׁבֶט (H7626, rod/staff). While שֵׁבֶט can metaphorically mean scepter, the grouping with needle and arrow indicates physical artifacts.
Contains דַּוָּג (H1728/H1771, fisherman) and ἁλιεύς (G0231, fisherman). In Louw-Nida classification, fishermen are categorized under fishing activities (LN44), not generic people (LN09).
Contains ὑπερείδω (G5237, overlook/disregard), παρακούω (G3878, neglect/disobey), ἀμελέω (G0272, neglect/be unconcerned). These are cognitive acts of neglect/disregard, not existence.
Contains רָפַף (H7322, shake/tremble), פָּלַץ (H6426, tremble/shake), φρίσσω (G5425, shudder/bristle). These denote trembling/shuddering, not numbers.
